adapter_policy: Renders one prerender unit into the project's delivery format (export.*, strictly: an unsupported codec, interlaced delivery or another rate is refused with a reason): the unit's pictures and samples decoded through the shared decode layer and decoder catalog at full size, encoded by the catalog's ffmpeg, each unit on a closed group of pictures with PCM sound so units are put together without encoding again. Written at its final name (the project folder denies renaming); whether a unit is complete is recorded in the project database by the caller. Reads media only through given endpoints (a card stays read only); no probe, no database.
